statement.text:
Suppose that φ is an automorphism of a finite soluble group G, and let r
be the (Prüfer) rank of the fixed-point subgroup CG (φ). Is the Fitting height of G
bounded terms of |φ| and r?
   This is known to be true in the case where |φ| is a product of at most two prime
powers (B. Hartley, Preprint, 1994, https://kourovkanotebookorg.wordpress.
com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/hartley94-prepr-mims.pdf). An affirmative
answer to this question would imply an affirmative answer to 13.8(b). E. I. Khukhro
